correctness.rationale: The three-deletion channel relation is A_yx=1 iff y is a length-(n-3) subsequence of binary source x. Each given witness has at most two sources containing any output, and rational dual weights w_y plus s_x=max(0,1-sum_y A_yx w_y) obey 1<=sum_y A_yx w_y+s_x for every binary source. Thus any feasible code has size <=2 sum_y w_y+sum_x s_x. For n=3..10 the exact certificate provides upper bounds 2,3,4,4,4,22/3,659/60,2693/180, whose floors equal the witness sizes 2,3,4,4,4,7,10,14. Independent BigInt exact enumeration of every source x and received word y and all eight certificate datasets verified all list capacities, rational upper-bound identities, and rounding gaps. These exhaustive finite checks prove the precise finite claim via duality; no unbounded n is asserted.
